# 200.00 USD paid to V-US out of the USD bank against BILL-USD-OVER for 100.00
# USD, entered in USD, so nothing in the entry says what the USD cost. The
# entry already divides the payable side: 100.00 settling the bill and 100.00
# left over. The bill's payment block gives the settling split with
# `txn_split_guid:` and declares the rest with `prepayment: 100`.
#
# What this fixture produces: the 100.00 USD left over is the vendor's debt to
# this book, and a cost basis at 1.40, the rate the bill was posted at, with a
# cost basis balance of 100.00. The entry states no cost, so `cost_basis_cost`
# is stored on the split.
#
# Load after `fx_usd_bill_cad_expense.txt`, with
# `--fx-rates tests/fixtures/fx_rates_usd_dated.yaml`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_the_credit_an_overpaying_wire_leaves_is_counted_once_however_it_is_divided.py.
2026-02-25 * "US Vendor - wire for BILL-USD-OVER"
	guid: "e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

bill "BILL-USD-OVER"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-OVER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1"
		txn_split_guid: "e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2"
